svg.text: ESP32-S3-N16R8 · Firmware v1.1.7 · 3.3 V logic · derived from esp32_singularity.yaml + hardware/*.md
Flow Loop — SM6004 (4-20 mA) → 0-3.3 V Converter → ADS1115
Converter J1 jumpers OPEN = 0-3.3 V mode · slope 7.57 L/min per volt
4.7 kΩ pull-up to +3V3 mandatory · both sensors share one DQ line
• 3.3 V ceiling: never apply 5 V to any GPIO or ADS1115 input. All 4-20mA converters set to 0-3.3 V mode (J1 OPEN).
• Every ADS1115 input (A0–A3) has a 100 nF cap to GND placed at the pin (HF filter). NTC dividers add C1/C2.
• Common ground: ESP32 GND ↔ ADS1115 GND ↔ 24 V PSU GND ↔ SSR DC− all bonded at one point.
• SSR gates: 10 kΩ pulldown holds heater OFF during boot. Independent thermal cutoff in series with the mains LOAD.
Heater / SSR Outputs — DC control (ESP32 side) | AC load (mains side)
⚠ Mains wiring: qualified persons only. Thermal cutoff wired in series with the LOAD, never the control side.
